title: Universal aimbot
features:
works for me

pasted asf

Keybind	Action
ALT + F1	Toggle UI visibility (show/hide the status overlay)
ALT + 1	Toggle ESP ON/OFF
ALT + 2	Toggle Aimbot ON/OFF
ALT + 3	Toggle Fly ON/OFF
ALT + 4	Toggle Noclip ON/OFF
ALT + 5	Toggle Speedhack ON/OFF
ALT + 6	Toggle Infinite Jump ON/OFF
ALT + 7	Toggle Teleport ON/OFF
Right Click	Aim at nearest enemy (when Aimbot is ON)
T	Teleport to mouse cursor position (when Teleport is ON)
WASD	Move in Fly mode
Space	Fly up
Shift	Fly down
